telos.statement: Choose the next move for paperclipai/paperclip#4328 so the intermittent blocked-state/comment inconsistency is diagnosed and fixed without committing to the wrong mechanism.
telos.success_condition: Preserve the competing mechanisms long enough to identify the cheapest discriminator that changes the production-fix decision, while avoiding a test-only patch that masks a real consistency defect.

current_state.summary: A CI test intermittently observes an issue status of blocked but zero expected comments. The blocked status is committed inside a transaction, while the comment is posted afterward. Several upstream operations and releaseIssueExecutionAndPromote errors are swallowed. Two mechanisms fit the symptom: the blocked branch may not have been legitimately selected because upstream state/classification differed, or the blocked branch may have committed status while addComment/post-transaction work failed. Suggested directions include logging the swallowed error, moving the comment into the transaction, or polling for the comment in the test.
known_constraints: Do not read the eventual issue comments or resolution before freezing the recommendation.
Do not assume transactionality is the fix merely because it would make the test deterministic.
A test polling change is acceptable only if production semantics intentionally permit status-before-comment visibility.
Prefer evidence that distinguishes upstream-state failure from post-transaction comment failure.

decision_blocked.statement: Should maintainers first make status+comment atomic, alter the test to wait for the comment, instrument the swallowed failure paths, or repair an upstream classification/race mechanism?
decision_blocked.current_default: Do not choose a production rewrite or test polling yet; first expose which branch/exception produces the blocked-without-comment state.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: A bounded reproduction or instrumentation result identifies whether status commits before comment failure versus an upstream state/classification path causing the inconsistency.

signals: Two mechanisms imply materially different fixes.
Current catch wrappers erase the evidence needed to choose between them.
The flaky test reproduces in CI but not locally in isolation.
A plausible fix could improve the test while leaving the production defect intact.
